manifest.name: Word Counter
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Displays word count for each card in the card footer

css: .mod-word-count { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; color: #888; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 6px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .mod-word-count::before { content: '📝 '; } body.dark-theme .mod-word-count { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #aaa; }
